title: Purification of Marine DNA Virus by Sucrose Density Gradient
author: Pauline Nogaret
materials: Purification of total DNA : Use the animal Blood or Cells (Spin column protocol) of DNeasy Blood and Tissue Kit (Qiagen). Dispense 200µL of the purified viral suspension in a clean microtube (tube 1). Use as many tubes as necessary to extract the whole virus suspension volume (tube 2, ....). For each tube : Add 20μL Proteinase K. Add 200μL Buffer AL (without added ethanol). Vortex and incubate at 56°C for 1 hour. Add 200μL ethanol at RT (100%) to the sample, and mix by vortexing. Pipette the mixture into the DNeasy Mini spin column placed in a 2mL collection tube. Centrifuge at 6800 g for 1 min 12°C (Eppendorf, 5427-R) . Discard flow-through and collection tube. Place the column in a new 2mL collection tube, add 500μL Buffer AW1. Centrifuge for 1 min at 6000 g 12°C(Eppendorf, 5427-R). Discard flow-through and collection tube. Place the column in a new 2mL collection tube, add 500μL Buffer AW2. Centrifuge 30s at 6000 g 12°C (Eppendorf, 5427-R). Discard flow-through and tube. Change collection tube and centrifuge for 1 min at 20,000 g 12°C. Column need to by dry. Place the DNeasy Mini spin column in a tube 1.5mL and pipette 100μL Buffer AE directly onto the DNeasy membrane for only tube 1. Incubate at room temperature for 1 min. Centrifuge for 1 min at 6800 g 12°C to elute DNA (Eppendorf, 5427-R). Transfer 100μL of eluate-tube 1 on the column “tube1”. Centrifuge for 1 min at 6800 g 12°C to elute DNA (Eppendorf, 5427-R). Transfer 100μL of eluate-tube 1 on the column “tube2”. DNA from tube 1 and tube 2 will be pooled. Centrifuge for 1 min at 6800 g 12°C to elute DNA (Eppendorf, 5427-R). Transfer 100μL of eluate- tube 2 on the column “tube2”. Centrifuge for 1 min at 6800 g 12°C to elute DNA (Eppendorf, 5427-R). Repeat these steps with the other tubes in order to increase the DNA yield. Keep 2,5µL for QuBit quantification (place this aliquot at -20°C if the quantification is done later) and store the DNA sample at -20°C.

steps.title: Culture Marine Viruses
steps.instruction: Grow 500mL of marine virus culture in the presence of its host in appropriate medium at 18°C, using a 12:12 h light:dark cycle of 100 μmol photons·m⁻²·s⁻¹ provided by a white fluorescent light.

steps.title: Clarify Viral Lysate
steps.instruction: Remove cellular debris from the 500mL viral lysate via centrifugation and filtration.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 5000 rcf for 30 minutes at 4 °C (Avanti J-25XP, Beckman Coulter-JA10 Rotor).
Carefully transfer the supernatant into a 0.45µm Durapore filtration unit and filter thoroughly using a hand pump.
Optionally, refilter using a 0.2µm filtration unit to remove additional debris.

steps.title: Concentrate Viral Filtrate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the filtered sample from its original volume down to 1mL.

substeps.instruction: Ultrafilter the filtrate using a Vivaflow 200 30kDa PES cartridge to reach a volume of 50mL.
Further concentrate the sample using a Vivaspin 20 30kDa PES centrifugal concentrator at 6000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C (Eppendorf, 5804-R).
Repeat the Vivaspin centrifugation, removing the filtrate after each step to prevent overflow, until the volume is reduced to 1mL.
Store the Vivaspin at 4°C overnight to improve virus recovery.
Transfer the concentrate into a 2mL microtube.
Rinse the membrane with 1 mL of appropriate buffer or ultrafiltrate and transfer the rinse into the 2mL microtube.

steps.title: Prepare Sucrose Gradients
steps.instruction: Prepare two sucrose gradients per sample using 10% and 40% (w/v) sucrose solutions.

substeps.instruction: Freshly prepare 10% (w/v) and 40% (w/v) sucrose solutions; sterilize via 0.2 µm PES syringe filter or autoclave at 121°C for 15 minutes.
Label open-top thinwall Ultra-Clear tubes and mark the half-full level (approx. 7 mL) using a Master Gradient marker block.
Fill tubes above the half-full mark with air-free, room temperature 10% sucrose solution using a sterile disposable pipette.

Using a sterile syringe and cannula, quickly insert the cannula to the bottom of the tube and layer the air-free, room temperature 40% sucrose solution until the heavy-light interface reaches the half-full mark.
Adjust the light solution volume to ensure the air hole is filled when the cap is inserted.
Level and calibrate the Gradient Master machine per manufacturer recommendations.
Place tubes in a MagnaBase magnetic tube holder on the instrument and generate the gradient using the 10%-40% sucrose gradient program.

steps.title: Separate Viral Particles
steps.instruction: Layer the viral concentrate onto the gradient and ultracentrifuge to separate particles.

substeps.instruction: Gently add 400-450µL of the viral concentrate to the top of the sucrose gradient.
Weight and balance the tubes.
Ultracentrifuge (Optima XPN-80, Beckman, Sw41Ti Rotor) at 4 °C for 30 minutes at either 134,400 x g (for cyanophages) or 68,600 x g (for micro-algae viruses).

steps.title: Collect Purified Virus
steps.instruction: Extract the viral band from the sucrose gradient.

substeps.instruction: In a dark environment, illuminate the tube from above with a lamp to visualize the white band containing the viruses.
Carefully pierce the tube using a 21G needle and a 1 mL syringe to collect the white band.
Transfer the purified viral suspension into a sterile tube (pool bands if multiple tubes were used for one sample).

steps.title: Clean Viral Bands
steps.instruction: Remove sucrose traces from the purified viral suspension using buffer washes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the purified viral suspension into the concentrate pocket of a Vivaspin 20 30 kDa PES centrifugal concentrator and fill up to 15 mL with SM buffer.
Centrifuge at 6000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C (Eppendorf, 5804-R).
Discard the eluate and resuspend the retentate in 10mL of SM buffer.
Centrifuge again at 6000 x g for 10 minutes at 4 °C (Eppendorf, 5804-R).
Repeat this cleaning step 2 times total to remove sucrose traces.
Store the viral suspension in the Vivaspin at 4°C overnight.
Collect the final purified viral solution (1mL).

steps.title: Quantify DNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the DNA concentration of the purified sample.

substeps.instruction: Quantify DNA using a Qubit 4 fluorimeter and the dsDNA BR Assay kit (detection range 4 to 2000ng of DNA).
Alternatively, use an Agilent Bioanalyzer for quantification.
